test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 03 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option 1) EI – LN**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52d150134ebd07cdaf3eb5b395b600997d1ea4a1a80b162447cbd181bc3cbda2.png] 

 

**Option 2) TX – AC**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1fd6e8e3c27a931d817a65bbd406ddcb3933c4b4b6ee77473d03633ac59970c.png] 

 

**Option 3) OS – WY**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97f09ee1dfd3cdb652e484be78209000da791d8abc7674e85f034c7899ce0748.png] 

The logic is not followed here as the shifts are +8 and +6.

**Option 4) AE – HJ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/652c1467af0fa4bc8b48d142dbc07c094a70503bfaf8dc61331908a611b245f7.png] 

 

Thus, the pair **OS – WY** does not belong to the group.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
